roles.label: ALSAP Lead
roles.note: Safety Statistician (QSEG) responsible for ALSAP development & maintenance. OWED SEED (2026-08-10).

roles.label: ALSAP Reviewer
roles.note: Cross-functional reviewer group (incl. Contributing Authors, SMT Co-chairs, BRT Chair, Asset/Research Lead, GCPL, GSTATL, RAPV Epidemiologist, Safety Programmer, EDTS Safety Rep). Group role — see open question on committee vs individual roles.

roles.label: ALSAP Approver
roles.note: Minimum: GSO, Medical Lead, ALSAP Lead.

roles.label: SAC Chair
roles.note: Leads the Safety Assessment Committee; typically Global Medical Safety Head (or designee) per SOP-AST-28304.

roles.label: Safety Programmer
roles.note: QSEG. Doc splits Developer vs Validator (segregation of duties). OPEN: two roles vs a duty attribute? Modeled as one role for the beta.

roles.label: Safety Management Team (SMT)
roles.note: A committee/body, not an individual. Same committee-vs-individual open question.

records.label: Asset Level Safety Assessment Plan (ALSAP)
records.note: The controlled plan itself; template FORM-AST-34037. OWED SEED (2026-08-10).
